subject: Renewal & Expansion: proposal timeline, exec QBR slot, and legal checklist
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@avasys.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@avasys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & Expansion: proposal timeline, exec QBR slot, and legal checklist

Hi Julie / Carlos,

Hope you both are well. With AvaSys's subscription coming up in July, I wanted to start a short renewal & expansion kick-off so we can align on timing, scope (commit uplift + optional premium support), and legal/ops asks. High-level proposal below — I included Ben on the thread for CS handoff.

Goal: convert current committed units to a 12-month committed plan + an optional 25% burst buffer for seasonal peaks.
Proposed timeline:
- This week (May 22–24): confirm business goals, capacity targets, and decision owners
- May 27–31: draft term sheet + pricing options (we'll prepare 2 tiered options)
- Jun 6–10: exec QBR to review usage trends, proposed uplift, and rollout plan
- Jun 14–21: legal/contracting review and sign-off
- Jul 1: new term effective date

Action items I suggest now:
1) Can you confirm target committed units (baseline + uplift %) and any hard budget constraints?
2) Please loop in your legal and procurement contact (or reply with their email) so we can surface redlines early.
3) Tell us 2x windows that work for an exec-level QBR in the week of Jun 6–10 (we typically book 30–45 minutes).

Attachments: draft term sheet (term sheet v1) and a sample SOW (stub) — they're early drafts just to anchor discussion.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to do a 15-minute discovery call tomorrow to confirm numbers before we build pricing.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion: proposal timeline, exec QBR slot, and legal checklist

Connor — thanks for the note and the drafts. High level: we are definitely interested in moving to a committed 12-month term with uplift; main asks from our side:

- Pricing clarity for 2x scenarios: (A) conservative uplift + priority support, (B) aggressive uplift + burst buffer.
- SLA language for latency/availability and an outline of remedial credits (our legal team will want that).
- Data retention & audit log export statement for compliance (we're in regulated healthcare workflows).

Decision owners on our side: myself (Customer Success/Platform), Carlos (Head of ML Ops), and I copied Procurement (procurement@avasys.com) — they should be the contracting contact.

QBR windows that look best for execs: Jun 7 morning (9:00–11:30 PT) or Jun 9 afternoon (1:30–4:00 PT). Either 45-minute slot works.

Let us know if you need any additional compliance artifacts (SOC 2, data flow diagram).

—Julie
Julie Park
Director, Platform Engineering | AvaSys
julie@avasys.com
